mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based recovery in consumer demand, which enhances corporate revenue visibility and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 94.0, combined with rising capacity utilization, signals an impending supply shock that disrupts production chains and increases inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 94.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment that raises discount rates and dampens equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL regimes (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 8.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 8.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 380,000 million dollars, coupled with falling housing starts, indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 380000.0 and HOUST < 700.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production above 96.0, combined with stable or falling unemployment, signals strong supply-side momentum that supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 96.0 and UNRATE < 8.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
